summary: Explains module defaults groups defined by collections in meta/runtime.yml action_groups and used with group/<fqcn> in module_defaults; collections keyword isn't honored so FQCN group names are required.
questions: How do I set defaults for a group of related modules?
How do I define an action group in a collection?
Do I need the full name for module_defaults groups?

answer_card.title: Module defaults groups
answer_card.answer_md:
Collections define groups in `meta/runtime.yml`:

```yaml
action_groups:
  my_group:
    - sample_module
    - another.collection.another_module
```

Use with the `group/` prefix and FQCN:

```yaml
module_defaults:
  group/ns.coll.my_group:
    option_name: option_value
```

`module_defaults` ignores the `collections` keyword, so use fully qualified group names.
